description: Check how search engines see one URL: whether Google and Bing may crawl and index it (HTTP status, redirects, robots.txt for Googlebot and Bingbot, noindex in meta tags or X-Robots-Tag, soft 404s), what its search result shows (title and meta description length, site icon), the canonical link, lang and hreflang tags, the mobile viewport, heading outline, images without alt text, internal links and link text, whether its JSON-LD structured data has the properties Google requires for rich results, and the main keywords estimated from where words appear on the page (title, h1, URL, headings, text), with a check that the main topic is in the title, h1 and description. Returns a score and copy-ready fixes. It checks one page, not the whole site, and has no ranking, search volume or backlink data. Use it for questions like "check my SEO", "why is my page not on Google" or "is my canonical right".

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain to check, for example "example.com/pricing". Private and local addresses are refused.

title: Check SEO
